title: Governed-agent benchmark task card (v1)
description: Versioned task-card schema for the governed-agent benchmark harness (FS-0031). A card declares a pinned base repository, a task prompt, governance constraints, and deterministic checks.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Unknown versions are rejected.

base_repo.description: Repository URL or local path the task runs against.

base_commit.description: Pinned base commit (full or unambiguous short SHA).

prompt.description: The task prompt handed to the agent.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths/actions the agent must not touch. May be empty.

required_plan_fields.description: Fields the agent's plan must contain (e.g. scope, steps, evidence).

required_evidence_fields.description: Fields the agent's evidence must contain (e.g. test output, diff, trace).

command.description: Shell command run in the worktree; exit 0 = pass, non-zero = fail.

max_steps.description: Advisory metadata — the v1 runner enforces timeout_seconds only; step counting is not yet implemented.
